scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir canisters/frontend install --frozen-lockfile && for c in site accounting vault; do (cd canisters/backend/$c && mops install) || exit 1; done
scripts.check: for c in site accounting vault; do (cd canisters/backend/$c && mops check) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:backend: for c in site accounting vault; do (cd canisters/backend/$c && mops test) || exit 1; done
scripts.admin:add: printf "Principal to add as admin: " && read p && [ -n "$p" ] && icp canister call site addAdmin "(principal \"$p\")" --identity "${ICP_IDENTITY:-anonymous}"
